title: MIUT official results archive
publisher: MIUT – Madeira Island Ultra-Trail / Clube de Montanha do Funchal
claims: The 2026 edition is labelled the 17th edition and its Legend winners are Vincent Esmiol in 12:48:03 and Katharina Hartmuth in 14:54:59.
The 2026 results list five races named Legend, Advanced, Discover, Marathon and Starter.

The 2025 edition is labelled the 16th edition and its flagship is still named MIUT 115 over Porto Moniz–Machico, with winners Paul Cornut-Chauvic in 12:54:52 and Katie Schide in 14:20:56; the other races are MIUT 85, MIUT 60, MIUT 42 and MIUT 16.
The 2024 edition is labelled the 15th edition and uses the same MIUT 115, MIUT 85, MIUT 60, MIUT 42 and MIUT 16 names.
The date line under the 2026 heading reads 26/04/2025, so the results page itself carries a year inconsistency.
